tokens.name: chassis
tokens.usage: App ground behind every pane; the darkest working surface except wells.

tokens.name: pane
tokens.usage: Pane bodies, headers, rails, dock and dialogs. One step above chassis.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, pressed-off toolbar buttons, menus and popovers.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Sunken code wells: listing, decompile, hex, log tail, inputs.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Fill for the one primary selected row, token or tab. Text on it is ink or ink-strong; ink-muted fails here (3.8:1), so promote secondary text to ink.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px separators between panes, rows and regions. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, buttons and checkboxes (3:1+ on chassis, pane, raised and well).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, row text and code on chassis, pane, raised, well and selection.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Titles, the selected row's primary label and headings on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary labels, timestamps, column heads, units on chassis, pane, raised and well. Not on selection.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only. Below 4.5:1 by design; never carries information.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single restrained blue: focus ring, active tab underline, links, splitter hover. Never a status.

tokens.name: address
tokens.usage: Addresses, offsets and RVAs in monospace wherever they appear.

tokens.name: fact-passed
tokens.usage: A named fact that passed with a receipt (compiled, objdiff equal, byte-identical). Text and glyph only; never a banner fill or celebration.

tokens.name: fact-caution
tokens.usage: Stale, partial, waiting at a gate, approval-required, not measured.

tokens.name: fact-failed
tokens.usage: Failed facts, faults, conflicts, contested locators, locked resources.

tokens.name: fact-unknown
tokens.usage: Unknown, unsupported and not_run facts. Always paired with a dashed glyph and the word.

tokens.name: lane-identity-fill
tokens.usage: Identity lane (stage 1) node header and diagram band. Keep text on it ink-strong; accent on it is 4.48:1, kept exact from the diagrams.

tokens.name: lane-identity-ink
tokens.usage: Identity lane title text and edges on chassis or pane.

tokens.name: lane-recovery-fill
tokens.usage: Source recovery lanes (stages 2-5, 8) node header fill.

tokens.name: lane-recovery-ink
tokens.usage: Source recovery lane titles and edges.

tokens.name: lane-unify-fill
tokens.usage: Cross-build unification and export lane (lane A/B) fill.

tokens.name: lane-unify-ink
tokens.usage: Cross-build unification lane titles; also gates in diagrams.

tokens.name: lane-runtime-fill
tokens.usage: Runtime reuse and learn-the-build lane (lane C) fill.

tokens.name: lane-runtime-ink
tokens.usage: Runtime lane titles and edges.

tokens.name: lane-verify-fill
tokens.usage: Verification and determinism lane (lane D) fill.

tokens.name: lane-verify-ink
tokens.usage: Verification lane titles and edges.

tokens.name: lane-intake-fill
tokens.usage: Intake / cross-cutting and distributed compute lane (lane E) fill.

tokens.name: lane-intake-ink
tokens.usage: Intake lane titles and edges.

tokens.name: lane-fault-fill
tokens.usage: Ownership lock and failover boxes in diagrams.

tokens.name: kind-gpr
tokens.usage: Session tab chip: local Ghidra .gpr project.

tokens.name: kind-shared-fs
tokens.usage: Session tab chip: shared-folder project.

tokens.name: kind-shared-http
tokens.usage: Session tab chip: shared Ghidra Server (RMI over SSL) repository.

tokens.name: kind-bin
tokens.usage: Session tab chip: raw binary with no project yet.

tokens.name: kind-draft
tokens.usage: Session tab chip: draft or scratch session.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind the command palette and confirm dialogs.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "DejaVu Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", "DejaVu Sans Mono", "Cascadia Code", Consolas, monospace
families.cond: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "DejaVu Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase region and column labels (NAVIGATOR, EVIDENCE, ADDR).

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Controls, tabs, menus, dock rows, chips.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text in panes, inspector prose, empty states.
styles.sample: A finished job is not a match.

styles.name: pane-title
styles.usage: Pane and dialog titles; the selected entity name in the view title bar.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Empty-state headlines and document headings inside the workspace. The largest size in the app chrome.
styles.sample: Select a function to decompile, rename, and match siblings.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Listing rows, decompile, hex, log tail, receipts.

styles.name: code-small
styles.usage: Addresses and hashes inside dense rows and chips.

styles.name: code-strong
styles.usage: The current listing line's mnemonic and the selected symbol in code.

styles.name: diagram-title
styles.usage: Title of a pipeline or contract diagram (the only place type goes this large).

styles.name: diagram-node
styles.usage: Stage and lane node titles in diagrams.

styles.name: diagram-note
styles.usage: Node rows and footnotes in diagrams.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between toolbar buttons; row inner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip horizontal padding; gap inside the action strip.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding; pane header padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Pane body padding; dock body padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; gap between inspector sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; diagram node padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between diagram lanes.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Panes, controls, tabs, rows, inputs, dialogs. The workstation is square.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Kind chips, fact badges, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-node
tokens.usage: Diagram nodes and lane bands only; never app chrome.

tokens.name: shadow-popup
tokens.usage: Command palette, menus, confirm dialog. Panes never cast shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Top edge of wells (listing, log tail).

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Default control, tab and row height at desktop density.

tokens.name: control-h-roomy
tokens.usage: Control height in roomy density and the navigation bar.

tokens.name: touch-h
tokens.usage: Minimum target below 700px width.

tokens.name: splitter
tokens.usage: Visible splitter rule; hit zone is 6px.

tokens.name: splitter-hit
tokens.usage: Invisible pointer and keyboard hit zone around each splitter.

tokens.name: navigator-w
tokens.usage: Navigator rail default (240-520px; side region under 1024px).

tokens.name: inspector-w
tokens.usage: Evidence inspector default (280-480px; behind the Inspector region under 1280px).

tokens.name: dock-h
tokens.usage: Activity dock default (120px to 65vh; never above the editor).

tokens.name: z-chrome
tokens.usage: Sticky header, session tabs, navigation bar.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and context menus.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Confirm and project dialogs.

tokens.name: z-palette
tokens.usage: Command palette.
